The eleven fixed PGLib-OPF v23.07 input cases are upstream CC-BY-4.0 data. Their raw .m files are excluded from the GridInstruct archive; derived numerical states are released with repository, version, commit, case filename, case hash, upstream license link, original attribution, source citations, and a notice that GridInstruct generated derived scenarios and records.

The PGLib verification is limited to commit dc6be4b2f85ca0e776952ec22cbd4c22396ea5a3 and the eleven hashes recorded in metadata/pglib_opf_v23_07_case_registry.json. A different upstream revision or case file requires a new audit.
